transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin underway so we can move toward final production approval. Let's start with each lead reporting their final operating requirements. Could we go in order: technical first, then rights, talent, and accessibility? I'll note any issues as we go and make the binding approval once everyone has reported.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras positioned from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure everyone is aware of this constraint now during the round-robin.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical rights issue to report. The signed performance license I received this morning — which is now countersigned — permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive, since that would constitute a VOD-style reuse beyond the broadcast. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but I'm flagging it now during the round-robin so it can be addressed before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have two critical talent issues to report. First, I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — this is not yet reflected in the production schedule. Second, the headliner's rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it hasn't been entered into the production schedule yet. The rider restriction directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision for a sponsor product display on stage. I'm flagging both of these now during the round-robin so they can be addressed before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a critical accessibility issue to report. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. I'm flagging this now during the round-robin so it can be addressed before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
